Kirsty was and is devastated and hasn't been doing much except crying in her room and going out clubbing with her friends. She has been like this for three months. and is starting to run low on money. Given that she has no chance of getting back into her career, I've been encouraging her to try to find some entry level work like retail/shop work or something like that. She sees it as a ''waste of her talents'' and thinks she's worth more than that. We have been arguing about it a lot. My wife Sarah and I don't need the rent from her, but at the same time she's been sitting here doing nothing for three months and asking for money from us. Sarah had a go at me, saying that it wasn't fair for me to ''threaten'' her into getting a job that isn't good enough for her even though we don't need her rent money. I think I did the right thing. Happy to be a shoulder to cry on about the loss of her career, but not willing to let her spend the rest of her life living of us.
